reviews.text: Linea is a ZK-rollup layer-2 on Ethereum by ConsenSys, focused on low-cost dApps. Launched in 2023, it supports EVM and has integrations with MetaMask. In 2025, it has grown with DeFi and NFTs. The team is reputable. It’s user-friendly but still building momentum.

Linea is an L2 scaling solution for Ethereum developed by Consensys. Technically, linea uses the zkEVM -zkrollup infrastructure. Transactions are processed in L2 and then sent to the main chain with zero-knowledge proofs (ZK Proff). Faster and lower-cost transactions are possible while maintaining ETH security. Linea is compatible with the Ethereum virtual machine(evm) – meaning dapps and contracts that run on eth can run on linea. Currency is linea. I have been a user for a long time, including the test net phase. Total supply is 72,009,990,000

Linea is another Ethereum-compatible Layer-2 (zkEVM) developed by Consensys and other partners (ENS, Status, etc.). Its objective is to make ETH the winning blockchain by building a fully Ethereum-equivalent rollup. Linea has one innovative feature, it plans to burn 20% of all fees in ETH, reducing ETH supply and aligning incentives. The remaining bridged ETH will be staked, and the rewards distributed to liquidity providers on Linea, giving, in this way, native ETH yield to users. Linea’s tokenomics is aligned with Ethereum, no private sale or insider allocations took place and most of the token supply is dedicated to builders and public good funding. It emphasizes full compatibility and support from enterprises like Mastercard with “no DAO” governance risk.

Linea is a high speed Ethereum layer 2 scaling solution that uses Zk SNAKs in order to achieve high scalability and ultra-low fees while maintaining full EVM equivalence and the security of Ethereum L1. The project was founded by very experienced team members from Consensys heavily funded by investors like SoftBank, Microsoft, and Temasek. Linear inter partnerships with multiple projects and institutions like SWIFT (which constitute top tier banks), Sharpink, Circle, Metamask, Uniswap, AAVE and Layerzero. The project uses strong security measures which include multiple up to date third party audits and active bug bounty program. Linea is managed by Trusted security council members in the initial stage. The protocol has a dual burn mechanism which brings about scarcity of Linea tokens. In my opinion, the project has good potential but the causes of concern about it are sequencer centralization and intense competition from other layer 2.

Linea is interesting to me as a new ConsenSys funded L2. It already shows explosive growth daily users quadrupled and nearly $2B TVL in early 2025, which is impressive. I also like their ideas of burning fees and giving ETH yield to users. The flip side is that it’s still early the team admits it’s still in its early stages, so it’s basically a new experiment on Ethereum. I’m hopeful but holding a bit of skepticism until it matures.

Linea is a Layer2 scaling solution built on Ethereum, designed to enhance transaction speeds and reduce fees using zk-rollups (zero knowledge rollups). By processing transactions off-chain and only submitting the necessary data to Ethereum, Linea improves scalability while retaining Ethereum’s security and decentralization. The project aims to provide a seamless user experience and empower developers to create high performance decentralized applications (dApps) that can operate efficiently without sacrificing security. Linea’s adoption has been growing, especially for applications requiring scalability and low transaction costs.
